'''''Bayesian Analysis''''' is an [[open-access]] [[Peer review|peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] covering theoretical and applied aspects of [[Bayesian methods]].<ref name=ISBA_BA>{{cite web|title=Bayesian Analysis|url=https://bayesian.org/resources/bayesian-analysis/|publisher=International Societl for Bayesian Analysis|accessdate=2017-10-24}}</ref> It is published by the [[International Society for Bayesian Analysis]] and is hosted at the [[Project Euclid]] web site.<ref name=Euclid_BA>{{cite web|title=Bayesian Analysis|url=http://projecteuclid.org/DPubS?service=UI&version=1.0&verb=Display&handle=euclid.ba|publisher=Project Euclid|accessdate=13 April 2013}}</ref>

''Bayesian Analysis'' is abstracted and indexed by [[Science Citation Index Expanded]]. According to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]'', the journal has a 2011 [[impact factor]] of 1.650.<ref name=WoS>{{cite book |year=2011 |chapter=Bayesian Analysis |title=[[Journal Citation Reports|2011 Journal Citation Reports]] |publisher=[[Thomson Reuters]] |edition=Science |series=[[Web of Science]] }} {{subscription required}}</ref>
